script:
control-agent-server conversation send "$T" --text 'hi' --no-run
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/run" --expect 200 --check success eq true
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/events/count" --query kind=$ACTION_KIND --check . eq 1 --until-ok 30
TCALL=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/events/search" --query kind=$ACTION_KIND --field items.0.tool_call_id)
control-agent-server state cat base_state.json --conversation "$T" --check execution_status eq running
control-agent-server restart --hard
PIDT=$(jq -r .pid "$AGENT_SERVER_VERIFY_RUN/run.json")
control-agent-server state cat owner_lease.json --conversation "$T" --check owner_pid eq "$PIDT"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T" --check execution_status eq error --quiet --save F31.crash-tool-call/get
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/events/search" --query kind=$AGENT_ERROR_KIND --check items len-eq 1 \
  --check items.0.tool_call_id eq "$TCALL" --check items.0.error contains 'A restart occurred while this tool was in progress' \
  --save F31.crash-tool-call/agent-error
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/events/count" --query kind=$OBSERVATION_KIND --check . eq 0
control-agent-server fixture llm-stub --name qa-f31-tool --step 'tool:finish:{"message":"QA_F31_RESUMED"}'
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/run" --expect 200 --check success eq true
control-agent-server conversation wait "$T" --until finished --timeout 60
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/agent_final_response" --check response eq QA_F31_RESUMED
control-agent-server sink read --name qa-f31-tool --contains 'A restart occurred while this tool was in progress' --expect-min 1 \
  --save F31.crash-tool-call/resumed-request
